purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0083 in the gauge arena: the coupling grows with distance at a rate proportional to the gluon color charge $C_A$, the same per unit $C_A$ in SU(2), SU(3) and SU(4), and the same for adjoint and fundamental sources, on top of the color-blind U(1) lattice artifact.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
